text: A confidential report and presentation recommending the award of a contract related to a multi-year special exhibit at the Toronto Zoo will be provided to the Board for approval at the upcoming meeting.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the confidential proposal referred by the Chief Executive Officer in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (January 24, 2019) from the Chief Executive Officer, titled 2019 Special Exhibit. 2. Directed the details of the approval be released at an appropriate time at the discretion of the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Zoo.
